proofSelection: Contract data only. Existing exact projection/identity/refusal tests are cited in docs/arch/kernel/embedded-codecs.md; new shared-codec behavior and cases belong to EMB0I. Consumer-specific integrations supplement, not replace, primitive acceptance.

cases.input: Same literal-shaped raw chunks under Vue, Angular and Lit profiles
cases.required: Shared primitives; canonical activation, grammar and hole dispositions differ only by admitted profile policy
cases.forbidden: Framework switch/name matching in neutral codec

cases.input: Cooked code units [0xD800] and [0xDC00], separately
cases.required: NonUnicodeCookedLiteral before embedded parsing, no embedded byte offset minted
cases.forbidden: U+FFFD/WTF-8/false UTF-8 position

cases.input: Authored \uD83D\uDE00; cooked units [0xD83D,0xDE00]
cases.required: Scalar U+1F600 as UTF-8 F0 9F 98 80; whole scalar maps to authored escape range; interior-byte queries refused
cases.forbidden: Surrogate-half UTF-8 offset

cases.input: Tagged template chunk with invalid \u{ZZ}; cooked absent; cooked policy
cases.required: MissingCookedValue before parsing
cases.forbidden: Automatic raw fallback or empty complete value

cases.input: Same invalid tagged escape, explicitly raw profile
cases.required: Exact authored raw spelling admitted if profile grammar permits; no cooked identity
cases.forbidden: Cooked absence rejects an otherwise raw-selected chunk

cases.input: Authored \u00E9, escaped backtick, escaped quote and escaped ${ opener
cases.required: Delimiter/escape policy declared; exact whole-escape provenance and UTF-8 scalar boundaries
cases.forbidden: Linear interpolation across an escape or invented hole

cases.input: Actual CRLF and lone CR in raw versus profile-normalized cooked chunks
cases.required: Raw bytes preserved; normalization records contraction and elided preimage; following offsets exact
cases.forbidden: Silent byte loss or wire columns cached as core geometry

cases.input: Backslash + LF and backslash + CRLF in host literal
cases.required: Host policy removes continuation from cooked bytes, map retains elision and next scalar origin
cases.forbidden: Zero-width fabricated editable origin

cases.input: Indented multiline literal; tabs, non-ASCII and empty line
cases.required: Declared indentation policy with exact removed-byte records; no implicit normalization
cases.forbidden: Dedent based on guessed language/hardware

cases.input: Empty literal, empty quasi at beginning/end and adjacent holes
cases.required: Offset zero/end valid only in exact domain; empty chunks preserve ordered hole lineage
cases.forbidden: Drop empty chunk and reorder holes

cases.input: Literal é, astral scalar, combining mark, ZWJ and BOM
cases.required: UTF-8 scalar boundaries, unchanged spelling unless declared policy transforms it
cases.forbidden: ASCII assumption or grapheme offset replacing byte offset

cases.input: Lit html chunk with ${user.name} in text/attribute and nested tagged template
cases.required: Ordered expression ranges and parent lineage exact; placeholder bytes synthetic; profile selects hole class
cases.forbidden: Placeholder parsed as authored expression or dynamic execution

cases.input: Angular template built from variable or interpolated literal
cases.required: Profile reports unsupported/dynamic attachment; neutral codec does not invent activation
cases.forbidden: Evaluate variable or borrow Lit hole semantics

cases.input: Nested regions at admitted limit and one deeper
cases.required: At limit exact; over limit typed partiality before excess work, no complete cache admission
cases.forbidden: Unbounded recursion

cases.input: Syntax -> preprocessor -> compiler -> runtime stage, with authored non-ASCII text
cases.required: Distinct stage identities/provenance; exact unit/content/map-basis joins; final admitted positions authored UTF-8
cases.forbidden: Collapse stages to one unqualified map

cases.input: Pug mixin output duplicated or relocated; stylesheet transform missing map
cases.required: Ordered provenance or Unmappable; rename/safe fixes refused without unique reversible preimage
cases.forbidden: Nearest token, spanning gaps, guessed unique edit

cases.input: Two Angular components share external template; relative asset path in template
cases.required: One resource unit/base URI, distinct attachment contexts; no component-file-start blame
cases.forbidden: Alias resource identity to component URI

cases.input: MDX nested JSX/ESM, Glimmer template tag, Marko script/style and Astro frontmatter
cases.required: Exact parent/child region geometry from profile; identity of surrounding regions survives local edit
cases.forbidden: Universal grammar or projection mask

cases.input: One composition stage has old ContentId/MapRevision or wrong source unit
cases.required: Typed mismatched/stale basis refusal; no complete publication
cases.forbidden: Re-map stale position approximately

cases.input: Range reaches synthetic bytes, rewritten interior or discontiguous/repeated origins
cases.required: Unmappable or ordered display provenance; no rename/safe edit unless every stage proves unique reversible range
cases.forbidden: Independent endpoint mapping treated as invertibility

cases.input: Same map segments and holes with perturbed discovery order, coincident mappings
cases.required: Canonical output ordering and declared coincident-segment order preserved; conflicting origins ambiguous
cases.forbidden: Last writer wins

cases.input: Splice/revert inside escape, between surrogate escapes, across CRLF, delimiter and hole boundary
cases.required: Incremental equals fresh bytes/maps/partiality/lineage/order; unaffected regions unchanged
cases.forbidden: Warm complete entry survives changed observed basis

cases.input: Malformed literal then repair; cancellation/stale publication during decoding
cases.required: Fresh equals incremental; degraded/cancelled/stale work never warms complete result
cases.forbidden: Empty complete fallback or stale admission

cases.input: Bounded deterministic generated UTF-8 chunks, cooked code units, escapes, holes, edits and stage joins
cases.required: Fresh/incremental and compose/direct answers agree on exact boundaries or same typed refusal; seed reproducible; depth/input bounded
cases.forbidden: Oracle using same decode algorithm or unbounded soak

cases.input: Input sizes n and 2n; identity raw, transformed cooked, many chunks/holes and nested chain; repeat warm query
cases.required: Counts/growth reported for validation/decode/map allocation; bound by input bytes+segments+holes+admitted depth; warm reuse avoids duplicate decode
cases.forbidden: Copy each prefix or parse/resolve in map callback; timing gate

cases.input: Plain carrier, inactive profile and selected-but-unrequested region controls
cases.required: No decode/embedded parse/map work without admitted demand; unchanged plain-carrier behavior
cases.forbidden: Eager decode all carriers
